editedExercise.name: Shadwo Boxing

instructions.description: Stand in a stable staggered stance with one foot slightly in front of the other. Keep your knees slightly bent, core gently engaged, and hands near your chin.
Extend one arm forward in a controlled punch. Rotate the fist naturally as you extend, keeping the wrist straight and the shoulder relaxed.
Return the arm to your guard position and punch with the opposite arm. Lightly shift your weight between your feet while keeping your stance stable.
Continue alternating punches at a comfortable pace. Keep your movements smooth and controlled, without locking or snapping the elbows.

commentsNotes: Keep your core engaged and torso controlled.
Punch forward without fully locking the elbow.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid excessive tension.
Focus on coordination and technique rather than punching with maximum force.
